label: PF Backlog 234
title: Parallel section/feature generation
body: Run sectioned/per-feature section calls in parallel (bounded worker pool) instead of serially; merge deterministically. Biggest wall-clock win; quality-neutral (order-independent).

brief.problem: Sectioned/per-feature generation runs agent calls serially, making generation wall-clock-bound.
brief.what_adds: Run section/per-feature agent calls in parallel with a bounded worker pool and merge results deterministically.
brief.why: Biggest wall-clock win; order-independent merge keeps quality neutral.
brief.who_feels: PF platform maintainers, workers, and customers.

objective: Run section/per-feature agent calls in parallel with a bounded worker pool and merge results deterministically.
acceptance_criteria: parallel section generation runs with bounded concurrency
approach: Run independent section calls in a bounded pool (respecting capacity), collect results, and merge deterministically (stable ordering); remain fail-closed on any error.
verification: parallel section generation runs with bounded concurrency
risks: one slow section stalls the merge
